name: evaluate
description: Evaluate the explicit mathematical expression supplied by the user. Use for numeric expressions written with operators, function calls, parentheses, unit conversions or symbolic calculator syntax. The calculator reads the unchanged expression directly from the request.

name: function
description: Apply a scientific math function or arithmetic operation to numbers or expressions.

arguments.description: Arguments in order, each copied exactly from the query. Use one list string for statistics, and one matrix string for matrix operations.

name: convert
description: Convert a measurement to another unit.

value.description: Measurement including number and source unit.

expression.description: Expression or equation copied from the query.

lower.description: Lower integration or root bound, if specified.

upper.description: Upper integration or root bound, if specified.
